plugin.name: Cards awaiting your decision
owner.label: From session "{owner}"
reason.workspace: Changes in the workspace need confirmation
allow.once.tip: Let this one through; the next similar action will ask again
allow.session.tip: Stop asking for similar actions in this session; resets when you switch sessions
allow.always.noRule: This kind of action cannot be persisted
allow.always.rule: Write a rule: {rule}… and allow matching actions from then on

diff.ambiguous: old matches several places; this run will fail
diff.fellBack: Cannot read the file's current content; the preview is inferred from the arguments
hardline: The safety policy blocks this step; it can only be rejected.
reject.tip: Skip this step and return the reason to the model; with no answer in 5 minutes it counts as rejected
plan.feedback: What should the model change? Write it here (optional); it is passed to the model as-is
plan.approve.tip: Approve and switch back to build mode to start implementing
plan.revise.tip: Stay in plan mode; you can add one line of feedback for the model to follow
plan.reject.tip: Give the feedback to the model and stay in plan mode to revise
ask.placeholder.multi: Pick several, or write the answer here
ask.placeholder.single: You can also write the answer here
ask.skip.tip: Skip this question and ask the next one
